lines.1: 「PE is great. It makes time fly.」
lines.2: I chatted away while lazily pulling on my dress shirt.
lines.4: 「Leo's great at finding the easiest job.」
lines.5: 「How rude. Call me energy-efficient. I don't generate unnecessary heat, so I'm good for the environment.」
lines.6: The girls had returned from their changing room, but at least they were back in uniform from the waist down, so there shouldn't have been a problem.
lines.9: 「Oh dear. A button just popped off your shirt.」
lines.11: 「Oh, I'll sew it back on for you.」
lines.14: Yoshimi promptly produced a sewing kit.
lines.18: She had stepped right into my territory.
lines.23: Yoshimi Sato, otherwise known as Yoppi.
lines.24: She hated being called Yoppi, but the Princess liked it, so the poor girl had been stuck with it ever since.
lines.25: She was almost always at the Princess's side.
lines.26: But she wasn't some hanger-on. She was more like a shock absorber who kept the Princess's rampages under control.
lines.27: Her gentle, kind nature made her popular with boys and girls alike.
lines.28: She was easy to talk to, and she'd even help you study.
lines.29: She was so sweet that some people joked she should be called Miss Sugar instead of Miss Sato.
lines.30: I liked her too--as a classmate.
lines.32: Not just her face. Even the casual way she brushed back her hair was so graceful and feminine, nothing like that childish Crab. How could I put it...
lines.33: Easy. Don't get swept up in the moment.
lines.34: Hell, I was mad at myself for getting this worked up just because she was sewing on a button.
lines.35: 「I have mixed feelings about how much happier you look than when I sew them on for you.」
lines.36: 「Hah! Look at Leo grinning like an idiot.」
lines.37: I could feel all those curious eyes on me.
lines.38: God, every second dragged on forever...
lines.41: 「Yoshimi, will you fasten the button on my heart too?」
lines.43: 「Ahaha, sorry. I couldn't think of how to play along with that one.」
lines.44: 「That's okay. I'm happy you didn't reject me outright.」
lines.46: Good. Time to pull myself together while she was distracted.
lines.47: I'd stare out the window and hide my embarrassment.
lines.50: A parrot was flapping away outside.
